scope: Frozen before new semantic source reading; existing runtime reviewed for maintenance context. No prior suite exists.

tasks.prompt: 用 Medium 校对：嗯，这个项目的试场很小，试场需求下降。声明无意义口头语删除，并解释专名/术语修改。

criteria.c1: Retain substantive information; fix 市场 only when context warrants
criteria.c2: Declare filler category; explain substantive change

tasks.prompt: 要求严格逐字保留：呃，不不不，我不是说不行，我是说还没决定。

criteria.c1: Preserve hesitations, restart and negation under strict verbatim
criteria.c2: Do not apply Medium deletion by default

tasks.prompt: 说话人明确把少数群体叫作一个冒犯性旧称。出版社想全部换成现在的用语。应如何交付忠实记录？

criteria.c2: Separate proposed publication adaptation from faithful record

tasks.prompt: 刘仲敬谈玻璃厂的玻璃碎了。混淆表里有玻璃→保利，能直接改吗？这个表是刘仲敬本人认可的吗？

criteria.c2: Credit Ariel Lee experience; no claim of speaker endorsement

tasks.prompt: 采访说“利率由4%变成5%，增加1%”。只能校对，不能改说话人的观点。
没有音频，甲乙两人标签看起来颠倒；只凭谁更可能赞成这个观点，能否换掉标签？

criteria.c1: Do not assign identity from ideological expectations
criteria.c2: Keep source labels and query uncertain turn

tasks.prompt: 研究可用的访谈文字，录音关闭。需要出版一段引文，指南能证明已经获许可吗？

criteria.c2: Historic guide cannot establish present publication permission

tasks.prompt: 请给这套 skill 在真实中文录音上的错词恢复准确率。

criteria.c1: No invented accuracy or confidence calibration
criteria.c2: Distinguish editorial review from measured evaluation
